name: SmartBackgroundChecks
instructions: Search smartbackgroundchecks.com for {full_name}. If you're listed, open smartbackgroundchecks.com/optout and remove your record, using {contact_email} where it asks for an email. This usually removes you from PeopleFinders too. Then press "I've done this".
source: Process per BADBOOL's SmartBackgroundChecks entry (the opt-out likely also removes PeopleFinders).
